band.basis: NET cost impact of switching 1200 m² of warehouse roof from long-run ColourSteel to a membrane, per m² of roof area (roof area = 1200 m²), GST exclusive, Auckland (AKL) rates — unregulated QV CostBuilder rows, unreviewed. = membrane covering $137–186/m² less ColourSteel covering $116–137/m² plus a $4–10/m² sundries allowance. Low bound pairs cheapest membrane with dearest ColourSteel; high bound pairs dearest membrane with cheapest ColourSteel. Midpoint ≈ $42/m². 1200 m² total: ≈ $4,800–$96,000 (centre ≈ $50,400). Membrane-alone rate $137–186/m²; ColourSteel-alone benchmark $116–137/m²; for 1200 m² membrane alone ≈ $164,000–$223,000 vs ColourSteel alone ≈ $139,000–$164,000. NOT INCLUDED (per pinned scope): removal/disposal of existing roofing, structural changes, insulation or ceiling work, flashings, gutters and drainage. KEY RISK: membrane normally requires a continuous substrate deck that long-run ColourSteel does not — if a new plywood deck is needed add ≈ $76–102/m² (QV rows ...t32:r2 17mm $76 and ...t32:r4 21mm $102, AKL), which would dominate the switch. CONFIDENCE LOW: QV has no TPO/PVC single-ply row (butyl proxy used); build-up and membrane type not yet decided; no NZ published TPO/PVC rate found on the web worth citing.

band.unit: NZD per m2 of roof area (GST exclusive)
band.basis: Cost-plan/replacement band for a warehouse membrane roof laid in place, priced from QV CostBuilder Roof Coverings membrane rows (double-layer torch-on modified bitumen at the high end; Soprasun 4AR double-layer at the low end), plus a small minor-items allowance. 1200 m2 roof area: approx $144,000 - $241,000 GST excl. Assumes a structurally suitable substrate/falls already provided and in place, and excludes removal/disposal of existing roofing, structural changes, insulation/ceiling work, flashings, gutters and drainage per the pinned scope. Priced as the membrane roof ALONE (no credit for the omitted Coloursteel). Cited long-run Coloursteel comparator (QV Steel & Aluminium Roofing in-place sheet rates), AKL: ~$64-111/m2 across corrugate/trapezoidal/Dimondek profiles (~$87-92/m2 for standard 0.55mm trapezoidal), i.e. switching implies roughly +$30,000 to +$140,000 over 1,200 m2. Confidence LOW because the membrane type/build-up is undecided, the specified single-ply option is unpublished, the substrate is excluded, and the QV rows are unreviewed.

band.unit: NZ$/m2 of roof area, GST excl, net additional cost of switching from long-run Coloursteel to a membrane roof (membrane + required substrate, less displaced Coloursteel sheet)
band.basis: Sum of three QV-priced components: membrane (1.5mm butyl, laid to falls, incl. lapped joints) $137-152/m2 + additional plywood substrate needed for a membrane over purlins $82-97/m2 - displaced long-run prefinished Coloursteel sheet $77-111/m2 = $108-172/m2 net (centre $140/m2). Over 1,200 m2 = ~$130k-$207k, centre ~$168k. Excludes removal/disposal of existing roof, flashings, gutters, roof drainage, insulation, ceiling, fall-forming, structural work and all design/consent fees - all omitted per the pinned scope and confirmed NOT included in the rates used. Membrane type is undecided; a torch-on double-layer selection would add roughly $20-45/m2 to the band, and a single-ply TPO/PVC system is not published in QV CostBuilder and would need a supplier quote. If the roof is priced on an existing suitable deck (no new plywood), the net impact falls to roughly $26-75/m2. Confidence low because membrane type, substrate and Coloursteel profile are all assumptions that move the answer materially. QV rates are unreviewed and centre-specific (Auckland quoted).
